notes: Read back through your chats is now called Memory scan, on the row that starts it, on the sheet that confirms it, and on the memories it writes — anything already credited to the old name is relabelled so the list reads consistently. Fixed while renaming it: the confirm sheet was clipping its own text at a fixed height inherited from the message preview it borrowed its styling from, which cut off the line saying how many requests the scan would make and that they are billed to your key. That is the one line on the sheet worth reading, so sheets whose text is the point are no longer capped.
